defects.defect: Button labels use a plain system sans-serif with no outline or drop shadow, clashing with the painted display lettering of the 'Victory' title and the rest of the fantasy UI
defects.direction: Use the game's display/fantasy face with dark outline and bevel for both plate labels
defects.region: 'Next level' and 'Home' button labels, y≈917 and y≈1038

defects.defect: Coin value is truncated to '12…' inside its chip while neighboring chips show full values
defects.direction: Widen the coin chip or abbreviate numerically (e.g. '12.3k') so the value is fully readable
defects.region: top resource bar, coin chip x≈250-380, y≈150

defects.defect: The two stacked action plates use inconsistent frame styles and sizes — the gold plate is a plain rounded capsule while the Home plate is a narrower wood bar with gem end-caps and a top/bottom gem, so the pair does not read as one button set
defects.direction: Give both plates the same frame construction, height, and corner treatment, varying only the gold vs dark fill

defects.defect: Card interior is a flat single-tone brown fill with no painted wood/parchment texture or inner bevel, so it reads as CSS rather than Kingdom Rush-style painted art; the title banner also sits on an opaque flat plate rather than compositing over the panel
defects.direction: Fill the card with a painted textured panel (wood grain or parchment) with inner shadow and highlight, and let the laurel/title art composite transparently over it

defects.defect: Gold total is visibly truncated as “12...”.
defects.direction: Widen or compact the currency display so the full value fits.

defects.defect: Coin total truncated to '12…' with an ellipsis inside the chip
defects.direction: Widen the chip or abbreviate the number (e.g. 12.4k) so the full value renders without truncation
defects.region: top resource bar, second chip (coin count)

defects.defect: Large empty gap between the laurel title and the cleared-level message leaves the upper card body looking unfinished and vertically unbalanced
defects.direction: Tighten the title-to-message gap and distribute the message, loot, and buttons more evenly in the card
defects.region: card body between message block and loot row, y≈740-800

defects.defect: Paused battle arena is an empty sand field with no units, enemies, or battle remnants visible around the card
defects.direction: Show the paused battle state (units/props) dimmed behind the result card

defects.defect: Stray dark rounded shapes and a small tab poke out from behind the card's left edge with no counterpart on the right, reading as an unfinished/misplaced frame ornament
defects.direction: Remove or mirror the edge ornaments symmetrically on both sides of the card frame

defects.defect: Header bar is disproportionately tall with the centered title block floating high and dead space beneath, and its frame style differs from the resource bar directly above
defects.direction: Reduce the header height and match its frame treatment to the resource bar

defects.defect: Hero portraits are tiny, low-contrast and nearly identical silhouettes inside their ring frames, so heroes are not visually distinguishable
defects.direction: Enlarge and brighten the portrait art within the ring so each hero is identifiable
defects.region: party HUD portraits, y≈1275-1320 (all three cards)

defects.defect: Dark semicircular notches protrude from the card's left border, reading as clipped or stray decoration on that edge only
defects.direction: Remove the notches or mirror an intentional binding motif symmetrically on both edges so the frame reads finished

defects.region: top resource bar, second chip (coin count)
